name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support to landholding farmer families across India
descriptionHi: भारत भर के भूमिधारक किसान परिवारों को प्रत्यक्ष आय सहायता
officialEligibility: Landholder farmer families who own cultivable land in their names as per state/UT land records. Subject to exclusion categories (institutional landholders, constitutional post holders, current/former ministers, government employees, pensioners with monthly pension ≥ ₹10,000, income tax payers, registered professionals).
officialEligibilityHi: वे भूमिधारक किसान परिवार जिनके नाम पर कृषि योग्य भूमि है। संस्थागत भूमिधारक, संवैधानिक पद धारक, मंत्री, सरकारी कर्मचारी, ₹10,000 से अधिक मासिक पेंशनभोगी, आयकरदाता और पंजीकृत पेशेवर इसके पात्र नहीं हैं।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (benefit is for landholder farmer family)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income ceiling; subject to exclusion categories)
officialDisability: Not specified in official source (eligible regardless of disability status)
exclusions: Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons
Serving or retired Government officers and employees (excluding Class IV / Group D / MTS)
Pensioners with monthly pension of ₹10,000 or more (excluding Class IV / Group D / MTS)
Income tax payers in the last assessment year
Registered professionals (Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, Architects)
officialSource: https://pmkisan.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Operational Guidelines)

name: Ayushman Bharat
benefitHi: ₹5 लाख स्वास्थ्य कवर/परिवार/वर्ष
description: Cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization cover for low-income & vulnerable families
descriptionHi: निम्न आय और कमजोर परिवारों के लिए कैशलेस अस्पताल भर्ती स्वास्थ्य कवर
officialEligibility: Deprived and vulnerable families identified based on SECC 2011 deprivation criteria and expanded NFSA / State beneficiary lists. Also covers all senior citizens aged 70+ under Ayushman Vay Vandana Card regardless of income.
officialEligibilityHi: SECC 2011 और NFSA के आधार पर चिन्हित वंचित परिवार। 70 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु के सभी वरिष्ठ नागरिक भी पात्र हैं।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (family coverage for all ages; 70+ under Vay Vandana)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (eligibility based on SECC deprivation / NFSA status, not a flat income cap)
officialDisability: Not specified in official source (eligible regardless of disability status)
officialSource: https://pmjay.gov.in (National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare)

name: National Scholarship Portal
description: Merit-cum-means scholarships for school and higher education students
descriptionHi: छात्रों के लिए मेरिट-सह-आय छात्रवृत्ति
officialEligibility: Students enrolled in recognized schools, colleges, or universities. Covers Post-Matric & Pre-Matric SC, ST, OBC, Minority, and General merit students based on specific scheme guidelines.
officialEligibilityHi: मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों में नामांकित छात्र। विशिष्ट योजना के अनुसार SC, ST, OBC, अल्पसंख्यक और सामान्य वर्ग के छात्र पात्र हैं।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (varies by scheme level from Class 1 to PhD)
officialIncome: Annual family income up to ₹2,50,000 (up to ₹4.5L or ₹8L for certain specific central schemes)
officialDisability: Not specified in official source (special provisions exist for students with disabilities)
officialSource: https://scholarships.gov.in (Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology / Ministry of Education)

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
description: Monthly pension for BPL widows aged 40-79 years
descriptionHi: 40-79 वर्ष की बीपीएल विधवाओं के लिए मासिक पेंशन
officialEligibility: Widows aged 40 to 79 years belonging to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL) as per Government of India criteria.
officialEligibilityHi: भारत सरकार के मानदंडों के अनुसार गरीबी रेखा से नीचे (BPL) जीवन यापन करने वाले परिवार की 40 से 79 वर्ष की विधवाएं।
officialAge: 40 to 79 years (transitions to higher old age pension rate at age 80)
officialIncome: Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
officialSource: https://nsap.nic.in (Ministry of Rural Development, National Social Assistance Programme)

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
description: Monthly social security pension for BPL senior citizens aged 60+
descriptionHi: 60 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के बीपीएल वरिष्ठ नागरिकों के लिए मासिक सामाजिक सुरक्षा पेंशन
officialEligibility: Senior citizens aged 60 years and above belonging to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
officialEligibilityHi: 60 वर्ष और उससे अधिक आयु के वरिष्ठ नागरिक जो गरीबी रेखा से नीचे (BPL) परिवार से संबंधित हैं।
officialAge: 60 years and above (₹200/mo for ages 60-79; ₹500/mo for ages 80+ from Central Govt, topped up by States)
officialIncome: Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
officialSource: https://nsap.nic.in (Ministry of Rural Development, National Social Assistance Programme)

name: National Pension Scheme for Traders
nameHi: व्यापारियों के लिए राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना
benefitHi: ₹3,000/माह सुनिश्चित पेंशन
description: Old-age pension scheme for shopkeepers, retail traders, and self-employed persons
descriptionHi: दुकानदारों, खुदरा व्यापारियों और स्व-नियोजित व्यक्तियों के लिए वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
documents: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account
officialEligibility: Shopkeepers, retail traders, and self-employed persons aged 18-40 years with annual turnover not exceeding ₹1.5 Crore. Must not be covered under EPFO/ESIC/PM-SYM or be an income tax payer.
officialEligibilityHi: 18-40 वर्ष के खुदरा व्यापारी और स्व-नियोजित व्यक्ति जिनका वार्षिक टर्नओवर ₹1.5 करोड़ से अधिक न हो।
officialAge: 18 to 40 years
officialIncome: Annual business turnover not exceeding ₹1.5 Crore (and not an income tax payer)
officialSource: https://maandhan.in (Ministry of Labour and Employment)

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana
benefitHi: ₹1.2-2.67 लाख तक की वित्तीय सहायता
description: Affordable housing assistance for homeless families and kutcha house dwellers
descriptionHi: बेघर परिवारों और कच्चे मकानों में रहने वालों के लिए किफायती आवास सहायता
officialEligibility: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca (permanent) house in any part of India. Classified into EWS (income up to ₹3 lakh), LIG (₹3–6 lakh), and rural houseless / kutcha house dwellers under SECC/Awas+.
officialEligibilityHi: लाभार्थी परिवार के पास भारत में कहीं भी पक्का मकान नहीं होना चाहिए। ईडब्ल्यूएस (₹3 लाख तक), एलआईजी और ग्रामीण बेघर परिवार।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (must be adult head/earning member of the family)
officialIncome: EWS: ≤ ₹3 lakh/year; LIG: ₹3-6 lakh/year; Rural: based on deprivation/kutcha house criteria
officialDisability: Not specified in official source (preference given in ground floor allocations)
officialSource: https://pmaymis.gov.in / https://pmayg.nic.in (Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs & Ministry of Rural Development)

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
description: Monthly pension for BPL individuals with severe disability (80%+)
descriptionHi: गंभीर दिव्यांगता (80%+) वाले बीपीएल व्यक्तियों के लिए मासिक पेंशन
officialEligibility: Persons aged 18 to 79 years with severe or multiple disabilities (disability degree of 80% or higher) belonging to a household living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
officialEligibilityHi: 18 से 79 वर्ष के व्यक्ति जो 80% या उससे अधिक गंभीर दिव्यांगता रखते हैं और बीपीएल परिवार से हैं।
officialAge: 18 to 79 years (transitions to higher old-age pension rate at age 80)
officialIncome: Below Poverty Line (BPL) household
officialDisability: Severe or multiple disability of 80% or more (certified by competent medical authority)
officialSource: https://nsap.nic.in (Ministry of Rural Development, National Social Assistance Programme)

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹10-20 lakh
benefitHi: ₹10-20 लाख तक का बिना गारंटी व्यापार ऋण
description: Collateral-free institutional credit for micro and small business enterprises
descriptionHi: सूक्ष्म और लघु व्यवसाय उद्यमों के लिए संपार्श्विक-मुक्त संस्थागत ऋण
officialEligibility: Any Indian citizen with a business proposal for a non-farm income-generating micro/small enterprise in manufacturing, trading, or service sectors.
officialEligibilityHi: विनिर्माण, व्यापार या सेवा क्षेत्रों में गैर-कृषि आय सृजन करने वाले सूक्ष्म/लघु उद्यम के लिए कोई भी भारतीय नागरिक।
officialAge: Minimum 18 years (no statutory upper age limit in central guidelines)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income ceiling; loan is for micro/small businesses)
officialSource: https://www.mudra.org.in (Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance)

name: Kanya Sumangala Yojana (UP)
benefitHi: 6 चरणों में ₹25,000 की वित्तीय सहायता
description: Conditional financial support for girl children in UP from birth to higher education
descriptionHi: जन्म से लेकर उच्च शिक्षा तक उत्तर प्रदेश में बालिकाओं के लिए वित्तीय सहायता
officialEligibility: Permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh. Maximum two girl children per family. Family annual income must not exceed ₹3,00,000.
officialEligibilityHi: उत्तर प्रदेश का स्थायी निवासी। प्रति परिवार अधिकतम दो बालिकाएं। परिवार की वार्षिक आय ₹3,00,000 से अधिक न हो।
officialAge: From birth up to higher education/graduation (stages: birth, vaccination, class 1, 6, 9, and degree entry)
officialIncome: Annual family income ≤ ₹3,00,000
officialSource: https://mksy.up.gov.in (Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh)

name: UP Scholarship Scheme
benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance
benefitHi: शिक्षण शुल्क प्रतिपूर्ति और रखरखाव भत्ता
description: Pre-matric and post-matric scholarship for students domiciled in Uttar Pradesh
descriptionHi: उत्तर प्रदेश के मूल निवासी छात्रों के लिए प्री-मैट्रिक और पोस्ट-मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
officialEligibility: Students domiciled in Uttar Pradesh enrolled in recognized schools, colleges, or universities in Pre-Matric (9-10) and Post-Matric courses.
officialEligibilityHi: मान्यता प्राप्त संस्थानों में प्री-मैट्रिक और पोस्ट-मैट्रिक पाठ्यक्रमों में नामांकित उत्तर प्रदेश के मूल निवासी छात्र।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (aligned with academic course requirements)
officialIncome: Annual family income ≤ ₹2,00,000 for General/OBC/Minority; ≤ ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST
officialSource: https://scholarship.up.gov.in (Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh)

name: Maharashtra Sanjay Gandhi Niradhar Scheme
description: Financial aid for destitute persons, disabled, and widows in Maharashtra
descriptionHi: महाराष्ट्र में निराधार व्यक्तियों, दिव्यांगों और विधवाओं के लिए वित्तीय सहायता
officialEligibility: Destitute persons, widows, divorced women, or persons with disability (40%+) domiciled in Maharashtra for 15+ years with annual family income up to ₹21,000.
officialEligibilityHi: महाराष्ट्र में 15 वर्ष से निवासी निराधार व्यक्ति, विधवाएं, दिव्यांग (40%+) जिनकी वार्षिक पारिवारिक आय ₹21,000 से कम हो।
officialAge: 65 years and above for destitute elderly; 18-64 for destitute disabled, widows, and orphans
officialIncome: Annual family income ≤ ₹21,000
officialDisability: Covers disabled persons (minimum 40% disability) as well as destitute elderly and widows
officialSource: https://aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in (Social Justice & Special Assistance Department, Govt of Maharashtra)

name: Karnataka Anna Bhagya Scheme
benefit: 10 kg free food grains per person/month
benefitHi: प्रति व्यक्ति 10 किलोग्राम मुफ्त खाद्यान्न प्रति माह
description: Free food grains / DBT cash support for BPL and Antyodaya households in Karnataka
descriptionHi: कर्नाटक में बीपीएल और अंत्योदय परिवारों के लिए मुफ्त खाद्यान्न / डीबीटी नकद सहायता
officialEligibility: Residents of Karnataka holding valid Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (PHH/BPL) ration cards.
officialEligibilityHi: कर्नाटक के निवासी जिनके पास वैध अंत्योदय या प्राथमिकता (बीपीएल) राशन कार्ड है।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (covers all members of the household)
officialIncome: BPL / Antyodaya ration cardholder status
officialSource: https://ahara.kar.nic.in (Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department, Government of Karnataka)

name: Stand Up India Scheme
benefit: Bank loan between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore
benefitHi: ₹10 लाख से ₹1 करोड़ तक का बैंक ऋण
description: Bank financing for SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
descriptionHi: ग्रीनफील्ड उद्यम स्थापित करने वाले अनुसूचित जाति, अनुसूचित जनजाति और महिला उद्यमियों के लिए बैंक ऋण
officialEligibility: SC/ST borrowers and/or Women entrepreneurs (of any social category) aged 18+ establishing a greenfield project in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading.
officialEligibilityHi: 18 वर्ष से अधिक आयु के SC/ST और/या महिला उद्यमी जो विनिर्माण, सेवा, व्यापार में पहला उद्यम स्थापित कर रहे हों।
officialAge: 18 years and above
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income ceiling; for bank credit)
officialSource: https://www.standupmitra.in (Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance)

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
benefitHi: पहले बच्चे के लिए ₹5,000, दूसरे (कन्या) बच्चे के लिए ₹6,000
description: Maternity cash benefit for pregnant women and lactating mothers for health & nutrition
descriptionHi: गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताओं के लिए मातृत्व नकद प्रोत्साहन
officialEligibility: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers aged 19+ belonging to socially/economically disadvantaged sections (BPL, e-Shram, PM-JAY, SC/ST, women with disability, or income ≤ ₹8L). Excludes women in regular government employment.
officialEligibilityHi: 19 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु की गर्भवती और स्तनपान कराने वाली माताएं जो वंचित वर्गों से हैं। नियमित सरकारी कर्मचारी पात्र नहीं हैं।
officialAge: Minimum 19 years at the time of pregnancy
officialIncome: Socially/economically disadvantaged sections or annual family income ≤ ₹8,00,000
officialDisability: Not specified in official source (women with disability receive priority categorization)
officialSource: https://pmmvy.wcd.gov.in (Ministry of Women and Child Development)

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefitHi: ₹1,000 से ₹5,000 तक की गारंटीकृत मासिक पेंशन
description: Guaranteed voluntary pension scheme for unorganized sector workers after age 60
descriptionHi: 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों के लिए गारंटीकृत स्वैच्छिक पेंशन योजना
documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account
officialEligibility: All Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years holding a savings bank or post office account. Any citizen who is or has been an Income-Tax payer is not eligible to join (effective 1 Oct 2022).
officialEligibilityHi: 18 से 40 वर्ष के सभी भारतीय नागरिक जिनका बचत बैंक खाता है। आयकरदाता इसमें शामिल होने के पात्र नहीं हैं।
officialAge: 18 to 40 years
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no numeric income ceiling; statutory exclusion of income-tax payers)
officialSource: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in / https://enps.nsdl.com (PFRDA, Ministry of Finance)

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, training stipend, and loans up to ₹3 lakh @ 5%
benefitHi: ₹15,000 टूलकिट प्रोत्साहन, प्रशिक्षण वजीफा और 5% पर ₹3 लाख तक का ऋण
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades (including Tailors/Darzi, Carpenters, etc.)
descriptionHi: 18 पारंपरिक व्यवसायों (दर्जी, बढ़ई आदि सहित) के कारीगरों और शिल्पकारों के लिए समग्र सहायता
officialEligibility: Traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools in one of 18 recognized traditional trades (including Darzi/Tailor, Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Mason, Cobbler). Family members in government service excluded.
officialEligibilityHi: 18 मान्यता प्राप्त पारंपरिक व्यवसायों (दर्जी, बढ़ई, लोहार, कुम्हार आदि) में हाथों और औजारों से काम करने वाले कारीगर।
officialAge: Minimum 18 years
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (engaged in self-employment in traditional trade)
officialSource: https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in (Ministry of MSME & Ministry of Skill Development)

name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana
benefit: 5 kg free food grains per person/month (35 kg/family for AAY)
benefitHi: 5 किलो मुफ्त खाद्यान्न प्रति व्यक्ति/माह (अंत्योदय के लिए 35 किलो/परिवार)
description: Free food grains entitlement for Antyodaya (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH) ration cardholders
descriptionHi: अंत्योदय और प्राथमिकता राशन कार्डधारकों के लिए मुफ्त खाद्यान्न योजना
officialEligibility: All beneficiaries covered under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), including Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) families and Priority Households (PHH).
officialEligibilityHi: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम (NFSA) के तहत आने वाले सभी लाभार्थी (अंत्योदय और प्राथमिकता परिवार)।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (covers all family members on the ration card)
officialIncome: NFSA BPL / Antyodaya eligibility criteria
officialSource: https://nfsa.gov.in (Department of Food & Public Distribution, Ministry of Consumer Affairs)

name: PM-YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
description: Scholarship for meritorious students from economically weaker and backward sections in Class 9-12
descriptionHi: कक्षा 9-12 के आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर और पिछड़े वर्ग के मेधावी छात्रों के लिए छात्रवृत्ति
officialEligibility: Meritorious students from OBC, EBC, DNT, and economically weaker sections studying in Class 9 to Class 12 in recognized schools with parental income up to ₹2.5-3.5 lakh.
officialEligibilityHi: मान्यता प्राप्त स्कूलों में कक्षा 9 से 12 में पढ़ने वाले मेधावी छात्र जिनकी पारिवारिक आय ₹2.5-3.5 लाख से कम हो।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (typically 12 to 18 years based on school grade)
officialIncome: Annual family income ≤ ₹2,50,000 to ₹3,50,000 depending on specific sub-scheme
officialSource: https://scholarships.gov.in (Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / Ministry of Education)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High sovereign interest (8.2%) with EEE tax exemption
benefitHi: 8.2% की उच्च ब्याज दर और पूर्ण कर छूट (EEE)
description: Small deposit savings scheme for girl child with high government interest and tax benefits
descriptionHi: उच्च ब्याज और कर लाभ के साथ बालिकाओं के लिए लघु बचत योजना
officialEligibility: Resident Indian girl child from birth until attaining 10 years of age. Maximum two accounts per family (one per girl, with exception for twins/triplets). Open to all income groups.
officialEligibilityHi: जन्म से 10 वर्ष की आयु तक की भारतीय बालिकाएं। प्रति परिवार अधिकतम दो खाते। सभी आय वर्गों के लिए खुला।
officialAge: From birth up to 10 years of age (account must be opened before girl turns 10)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income limit; open to all families)
officialSource: https://www.indiapost.gov.in (National Savings Institute, Ministry of Finance)

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
benefit: Institutional welfare support, education access, and advocacy
benefitHi: संस्थागत कल्याणकारी सहायता, शिक्षा प्रोत्साहन और जागरूकता
description: National advocacy campaign to improve child sex ratio and promote girl child education
descriptionHi: बाल लिंगानुपात में सुधार और बालिकाओं की शिक्षा को बढ़ावा देने के लिए राष्ट्रीय अभियान
officialEligibility: National campaign for all girl children across India. Note: BBBP is an advocacy and institutional awareness initiative; it does NOT offer direct cash transfers or individual deposit accounts to citizens.
officialEligibilityHi: भारत भर की सभी बालिकाओं के लिए राष्ट्रीय अभियान। नोट: यह जन-जागरूकता और संस्थागत अभियान है, इसमें कोई प्रत्यक्ष नकद हस्तांतरण नहीं होता है।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (comprehensive child welfare initiative)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income restriction; public advocacy initiative without direct cash transfer)
officialSource: https://wcd.nic.in (Ministry of Women and Child Development)

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
benefit: Zero-balance bank account, ₹2 lakh accident cover, ₹10k overdraft
benefitHi: शून्य-शेष बैंक खाता, ₹2 लाख दुर्घटना बीमा, ₹10,000 ओवरड्राफ्ट
description: National mission for financial inclusion providing universal access to banking facilities
descriptionHi: बैंकिंग सुविधाओं तक सार्वभौमिक पहुंच प्रदान करने वाला राष्ट्रीय वित्तीय समावेशन मिशन
documents: Aadhaar Card (or any Officially Valid Document / Voter ID / PAN / Driving License)
officialEligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 10 years and above who does not already have a basic savings bank account. No minimum balance required.
officialEligibilityHi: 10 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु का कोई भी भारतीय नागरिक। न्यूनतम शेष राशि की कोई आवश्यकता नहीं है।
officialAge: 10 years and above (minor accounts from age 10)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income restriction; zero balance basic account)
officialSource: https://pmjdy.gov.in (Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance)

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
benefit: Comprehensive crop loss insurance at 1.5-2% subsidized farmer premium
benefitHi: 1.5-2% रियायती प्रीमियम पर व्यापक फसल नुकसान बीमा
description: Affordable crop loss insurance against non-preventable natural risks for farmers
descriptionHi: किसानों के लिए प्राकृतिक आपदाओं से फसल क्षति के विरुद्ध किफायती फसल बीमा
officialEligibility: All farmers (including sharecroppers and tenant farmers) growing notified crops in notified areas who have an insurable interest in the cultivated crop.
officialEligibilityHi: अधिसूचित क्षेत्रों में अधिसूचित फसल उगाने वाले सभी किसान (बटाईदार और काश्तकार किसानों सहित)।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (any adult farmer with insurable crop interest)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (no income ceiling; covers small, marginal, and large farmers)
officialSource: https://pmfby.gov.in (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare)

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil test card with crop-wise nutrient & fertilizer advice every 3 years
benefitHi: हर 3 साल में फसल-वार पोषक तत्व और उर्वरक सलाह के साथ मुफ्त मृदा परीक्षण कार्ड
description: Free soil nutrient testing and customized fertilizer advisory to optimize crop yield
descriptionHi: फसल की पैदावार बढ़ाने के लिए मुफ्त मिट्टी परीक्षण और अनुकूलित उर्वरक सलाह
officialEligibility: All farmers across India who hold or cultivate agricultural land.
officialEligibilityHi: भारत भर के वे सभी किसान जो कृषि भूमि के धारक हैं या खेती करते हैं।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (any landholding or cultivating farmer)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (free public service, no income criteria)
officialSource: https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in (Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare)

name: Tamil Nadu Free Laptop Scheme
benefit: Free laptop computer for higher education students
benefitHi: उच्च शिक्षा के छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त लैपटॉप कंप्यूटर
description: Free laptop distribution for students studying in Government and aided schools/colleges in Tamil Nadu
descriptionHi: तमिलनाडु के सरकारी और सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों/कॉलेजों में पढ़ने वाले छात्रों के लिए मुफ्त लैपटॉप
officialEligibility: Students studying in or passed Class 12 from Government and Government-aided schools, Arts & Science colleges, Engineering colleges, and Polytechnics in Tamil Nadu.
officialEligibilityHi: तमिलनाडु के सरकारी और सहायता प्राप्त स्कूलों और कॉलेजों में पढ़ने वाले छात्र।
officialAge: Not specified in official source (based on school/college enrollment, typically 16-22 years)
officialIncome: Not specified in official source (institutional enrollment based, not income means-tested)
officialSource: https://elcot.in (Special Programme Implementation Department, Govt of Tamil Nadu)
